This defeats eval_runner.py's own per-record adaptive redistribution (_effective_record_decode_timeout, eval_runner.py:1187-1208), which is designed to reallocate unused wall time across remaining records but only functions at chunk granularity -- with chunk_record_n==n(3) there is only one chunk, so there is nothing to redistribute across.
